finding.headline: "The Safe-Sleep Confusion"
finding.problem: "My mother says 'just put the baby in bed with you, that's what we did.' The hospital leaflet says that kills babies. I want to honour her but I'm terrified. What do I actually buy to sleep safely?"
finding.person: Nigerian mum told by grandmother to co-sleep (omugwo tradition) but seeing UK/Naija health warnings about SIDS; doesn't know what to buy for sleep.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone (high emotional charge — SIDS fear).". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
